legs.summary: Ascend the treacherous switchback ladders of Mt. Gelmir from the Bridge of Iniquity. Patches kicks you off a ledge as a warning here — speak to him before continuing. The Primeval Sorcerer Azur and Hermit Village are reached by descending the southeast face.

steps.text: From the Bridge of Iniquity grace (reached from the northwest Altus plateau road), climb the successive ladders up the volcanic cliff face. Patches is positioned on a cliff edge ahead — he kicks you off as a 'warning.' Survive the fall, then speak to him for dialogue.

steps.note: Stele at the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, on the switchback road.

legs.summary: The Hermit Village on the southeast Gelmir face is inhabited by exiled sorcerers and demi-humans. Demi-Human Queen Maggie guards the path to Primeval Sorcerer Azur, who gives Comet Azur freely. Loop back via the Seethewater River area for dungeon items.

steps.text: Descend from the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite southeast toward the Hermit Village. The Demi-Human Queen Maggie guards the courtyard before Primeval Sorcerer Azur.

steps.note: Given freely by Primeval Sorcerer Azur — speak to him at his throne. One of the most powerful sorceries in the game.

legs.summary: Two challenging dungeons with strong loot. The Gelmir Hero's Grave chariot dungeon hides a Bloodhound Knight and Gelmir Knight set. Wyndham Catacombs (north plateau) contains the Pearldrake Talisman +1.

steps.text: Gelmir Hero's Grave is reached from the Road of Iniquity / northwest Gelmir approach. Dodge the chariot in the first hallway; drop into the pit on the left side to find a hidden passage through a window, down a ladder to a Bloodhound Knight guarding the Gelmir Knight Set.

legs.summary: CRITICAL QUEST HUB — Volcano Manor holds three assassination contracts that MUST all be completed before fighting Rykard. Killing Rykard first permanently ends Tanith's questline, forfeiting: Taker's Cameo (Contract 3), Serpentbone Blade (Contract 2), Magma Whip Candlestick (Patches contract), Gelmir's Fury (Bernahl co-op), and the Rya questline resolution.

steps.text: Reach Volcano Manor by: (A) riding north from the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite up the lava-field road, (B) teleporting with Rya at Lux Ruins on Altus Plateau (requires returning her necklace in Liurnia), or (C) Abductor Virgin grab-death from Raya Lucaria basement. Option B is recommended.
Rya waits at Lux Ruins, Altus Plateau. Accept her offer to be transported to the manor entrance. Requires the Volcano Manor Invitation given when you returned her necklace in Liurnia.

steps.note: Given by Rya at Lux Ruins on Altus Plateau — requires having returned her necklace in Liurnia (purchased from Boggart for 1,000 runes).

steps.text: Speak to Lady Tanith in the main hall and join the Recusants. She gives you the Drawing Room Key.

steps.note: Given by Tanith when you join the Recusants. Opens the drawing room for assassination contracts and guest rooms.

steps.text: CONTRACT 1 — Old Knight Istvan: Take the first letter from the drawing room table. Invade and defeat Old Knight Istvan at the colosseum approach in Stormhill (Limgrave). Return to Tanith. REWARD: Magma Shot. Patches is also available in the manor now — he assigns Great-Horned Tragoth for his own contract (Tragoth is summoned as an NPC for Magma Wyrm Makar at Ruin-Strewn Precipice).

steps.note: Given by Tanith after completing Contract 1 (Old Knight Istvan).
Dropped by Old Knight Istvan during Contract 1 invasion at Stormhill.

steps.text: After Contract 1, speak with Rya in the drawing room. Enter the locked bedroom across the hall to find her in serpent form (Zorayas). Exhaust her dialogue.

CONTRACT 2 — Rileigh the Idle: Take the second letter. Invade and defeat Rileigh the Idle in Altus Plateau's eastern gorge. Bernahl afterward gives you a letter inviting co-op at the Fortified Manor (Leyndell). REWARD: Serpentbone Blade.

steps.note: Given by Tanith after completing Contract 2 (Rileigh the Idle).

steps.text: After Contract 2, find the illusory wall in the corridor and enter Prison Town. Defeat the Godskin Noble and get the Serpent's Amnion from the chest beyond. Give it to Rya. Optionally ask Tanith about the Tonic of Forgetfulness (she gives it if Rya's condition is discussed — use the tonic later at Mountaintops to resolve Rya's arc peacefully).

steps.note: Chest in the Prison Town area after defeating the Godskin Noble. Give to Rya. This triggers her three-ending branch.

steps.text: Godskin Noble — in the Prison Town Church area of the Volcano Manor interior. Required to access the Serpent's Amnion chest.

steps.note: Dropped by the Godskin Noble in Prison Town.

steps.text: Speak to Bernahl in the drawing room after Contract 2. He invites you to assist him at the Fortified Manor in Leyndell — defeat the phantoms Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm together. Return for Gelmir's Fury sorcery.

steps.note: Given by Bernahl after the Fortified Manor co-op invasion (Vargram the Raging Wolf + Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm).
Dropped by Vargram the Raging Wolf at the Fortified Manor in Leyndell.

steps.text: CONTRACT 3 — Juno Hoslow: Take the Red Letter from the drawing room. Invade and defeat Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood at Mountaintops of the Giants (Zamor Ruins area — requires Grand Lift of Rold). Return to Tanith. REWARD: Taker's Cameo. This is the final contract — DO THIS before speaking to Tanith about fighting Rykard.

missable.note: Fighting Rykard before completing all three contracts permanently ends Tanith's questline. Forfeits: Taker's Cameo, and access to future Tanith/Rya quest steps.

legs.summary: After completing ALL THREE contracts, Tanith transports you to Rykard's chamber. Pick up the Serpent Hunter from just inside the fog gate before engaging. After Rykard's death, Tanith moves to consume his corpse — speak to her there for a final exchange, then return for Bernahl's Farum Azula invasion reward.

steps.text: VERIFY before proceeding: (1) Old Knight Istvan dead, (2) Rileigh the Idle dead, (3) Juno Hoslow dead (Mountaintops required), (4) Bernahl's Fortified Manor co-op complete. When all done, speak to Tanith and choose to be teleported to Rykard.

steps.note: On a corpse just inside Rykard's fog gate. Pick up BEFORE engaging — it generates ranged light blades and trivializes both phases.

steps.text: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy — Phase 1: God-Devouring Serpent (30,439 HP), Phase 2: Rykard (59,174 HP). Use the Serpent Hunter for safe ranged damage. Killing him ends the Volcano Manor questline.

steps.note: Dropped by Rykard. Exchange at Roundtable Hold Finger Reader for Blasphemous Blade or Rykard's Rancor.
Dropped by Rykard. Activate at the Divine Tower of West Altus (the sealed gate to the east of the plateau).
